- **Expanded by default**, collapsible from its header (the choice is remembered in `localStorage`)"},{"id":"p10s4","text":".
- **Click a row → the conversation opens in its original workspace.** It uses the official `uiWork"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"space.openSession()` call, exactly like clicking that row in the sidebar: same working directory, sa"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"me context, same history.
- **Rows are not duplicated into a private store.** The group reads the Ho"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"st's own `pinnedSessionIds` and workspace membership; pinning/unpinning stays the shipped 📌 action ("},{"id":"p10s8","text":"plus a ✕ on hover).
- **Origin is visible.** Each row shows the workspace it belongs to; hover it fo"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"r the full title.
- **Live activity at a glance.** While something is happening the row's leading gl"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"yph becomes a dot: **pulsing** while the conversation runs, **amber** while it waits for approval, a"},{"id":"p10s11","text":" plan review or an answer, **green** for an unread completion (same source as the shipped status dot"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"s, so it updates live).
- **Per-row actions without leaving the group.** Hover a row for its ⋯ menu:"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" **rename**, **fork**, **copy session ID**, **unpin**, or **archive** — all through the same calls t"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"he shipped rows make (`session.rename`, `forkSession`, `unpinSession`, `archiveSession`). **Double-c"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"lick a title** to rename it in place (Enter saves, Escape cancels). Archiving a conversation that is"},{"id":"p10s16","text":" still running asks *stop and archive* first instead of silently ending its work.
- **Original rows "},{"id":"p10s17","text":"stay.** A pinned conversation is still listed under its own workspace — the Pinned group is an extra"},{"id":"p10s18","text":" entry point, not a move.
- **Archived section.** A collapsed *Archived N* entry under the rows expa"},{"id":"p10s19","text":"nds into the archived conversations, each with a one-click restore (`uiWorkspace.unarchiveSession`) "},{"id":"p10s20","text":"— archiving by accident no longer means hunting through the full archive view. It is **collapsed by "},{"id":"p10s21","text":"default** and shows **at most the 10 most recent** items; a muted *Show all · N* row reveals the res"},{"id":"p10s22","text":"nd shows **at most the 10 most recent** items; a muted *Show all · N* row reveals the rest.

The **Pinned** group appears at the top of the conversation list."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Surface | DeepSeek Harness **Web GUI** (the Desktop app renders the same Web surface) |
| Tested w"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ith | `0.2.1-rc.2` on Windows |
| Host half | none — it is a no-op; everything runs in the browser |"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"
| Credentials / network | none |
| Sidebar | required; TUI/headless profiles have nothing to attach"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"edentials / network | none |
| Sidebar | required; TUI/headless profiles have nothing to attach to |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Because it attaches to the sidebar list, a DSH release that restructures that list may require a sma"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ll adaptation (see How it works); the plugin degrades to "no group" rather than breaking the app."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The shipped Workspace browser owns the **single** `sidebar.workspaces` slot, so there is no slot to "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"add a group inside its list. Replacing the whole browser would mean reimplementing the app's session"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" list and would break on upgrades. The smallest intervention is a sibling group at the top:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. The plugin mounts one **invisible seat** in the sidebar shell (`sidebar.footer.action`, an empty "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"action beside Settings; the seat renders nothing).
2. From that seat's own DOM node it walks up to t"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"he browser's list area, then finds the scroll container.
3. It inserts one host element as the list'"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"s **first child** and portals the group into it, adopting the shipped group wrapper class so native "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"spacing applies.
4. A `MutationObserver` (plus a slow fallback tick) re-attaches the host after Reac"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"t rebuilds the list."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"It only **inserts**, never hides or reorders anything the app renders."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Security and privacy"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **No network requests, no telemetry, no credentials.** The Host half is an empty `apply()`.
- **Re"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ads** the Host workspace and session snapshots the sidebar already displays (titles, ids, timestamps"},{"id":"p26s3","text":", workspace membership).
- **Writes** exactly one browser key: `localStorage['dsh-pinned-panel.sideb"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ar.collapsed']`. Pin changes are the app's own actions through `uiWorkspace`.
- **DOM**: inserts one"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" host element as the first child of the sidebar list and renders into it with a React portal. Nothin"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"g else in the app is modified, hidden, or reordered.
- **Styles**: an inline `<style>` element regis"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"tered with the plugin's lifetime and using only DSH theme tokens."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- The group is a **display-layer insert**. It does not change session order or write extra state; th"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e app's own "pinned first inside the group" ordering is untouched.
- Pinned conversations that belon"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"g to **no** workspace are shown inline without an origin label.
- Rows are ordered by last update (n"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ewest first).
- This plugin follows the app's pin semantics. It does not add its own pin storage, so"},{"id":"p28s5","text":" everything stays consistent across reloads and browsers.
- A future DSH release that restructures t"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"he sidebar browser may require adapting the seam (the suffixes above are the contract)."}],"truncated":true}
